correctness.rationale: Periodic recurrence x_{k+1}+x_{k-1}=1+|x_k| is equivalent for each of all 2^p sign words to an affine rational system with closed sign inequalities, including zero coordinates. Exact Gaussian elimination handles regular and singular systems; rational Fourier–Motzkin elimination decides every affine feasible cell. The script actually enumerates all p<=11 and classifies feasible singular cells; independently written linear solving plus LP feasibility reproduced all 11 feasible word counts and all primitive isolated orbit counts. Strict nonzero coordinates of enumerated 5-/11-cycles allow exact derivative products with stated traces. No claim is made beyond period 11 or that all period-six cycles are isolated.

MathWorld presents one period-five orbit in five outer hexagonal regions; the independently verified second hyperbolic five-orbit lies outside that restricted picture. The original Devaney 1984 article could not be materially read; the possibility of historical exact short-period data remains a residual risk. Best-of-knowledge original for the complete global <=11 rational sign-word census.
